G.short_description: Procedural geomorphology derived from accepted G7 semantic fields and G3/G5/G6 surface, feature and hydrology truth.
G.purpose: Add deterministic valley, river-channel, bank, floodplain and erosion/deposition shaping without taking ownership of persistent Matter mutations, world identity, authority, persistence or material ontology.
G.expected_outcome: A replaceable, provenance-friendly geomorphology layer that produces stable surface deformation independent from SurfaceCellKey, LOD, camera and representation and can later feed geology/volume/detail stages.

T.short_description: Construction composition/failure/recovery semantics over accepted T1A.7 runtime recovery, interest and selective-scale evidence.
T.purpose: Make multi-fixture Construction failure and recovery explicit in canonical runtime state while reusing existing store, persistence, authority and network foundations.
T.expected_outcome: Runtime subjects expose deterministic operability/failure semantics, dependency failures propagate in bounded deterministic ways, commands obey explicit operability policy, and checkpoint/reconnect composition converges through the existing durability and replication foundations before heterogeneous T2 scale.
T.progress_note: T1B.2 Runtime Command Failure Semantics is ACCEPTED on exact Windows checkout 067fa6d8440ecc52771a5b8b5bb7a1e66b075192 by the required focused/full execution sequence. Supplied full evidence passes MW9 durable handoff 225, MW9 retry 12, MW10 transactions 184, MW10 processes 51, RL0 92, RL1 245, RL2 Matter 153, RL2 asteroid 44, RL3 representation-aware 175, RL3 processes 37, main_scene_cli_all 6 PASS / 0 FAIL, STOPPED, exit 0 and the NX4 final marker. T1B.3 is implemented as a lab-only composition over accepted T1A.7 M0 recovery, T1A.7.2 interest/session binding, T1B.1 bounded failure propagation, T1B.2 command policy, ConstructionRuntimeSnapshot and ConstructionRuntimeReplicaStore. Acceptance covers outage -> rejected/ledgered command -> checkpoint -> restart -> recovered failure truth -> external authoritative interest projection restore -> reconnect and late-interest full baselines -> dependency recovery -> ONLINE replica convergence -> command re-enabled -> second checkpoint/restart with successful replay. Interest/session state is explicitly not persisted inside Construction runtime truth. T2.0 remains blocked until C22 MAIN_INTEGRATED + TS0.4 ceiling classification + PC0 convergence.
T.next_stage: Run standalone T1B.3 recovery/reconnect composition and RUN_T1B3_RECOVERY_RECONNECT_TESTS.ps1 on exact Windows double Godot. If green, preserve the exact checkout and run RUN_WORLD_REGRESSION_TESTS.ps1 without fetch/reset. Only T1B.3 acceptance unlocks T1B.4 Composition Acceptance.

CH.expected_outcome: A persistent dedicated server and live clients can equip through the existing ITEM channel, restart/recover, reconnect and late-join while the same canonical Item UUIDs automatically drive local and remote CharacterEquipment presentation exactly once.
CH.progress_note: CH9.5 is FOCUSED_ACCEPTED. The complete CH9.5 candidate runner also passes editor import, CH9.2 composition 59, CH9.3 replicated presentation 27, CH9.3 real ENet 20, CH9.4 durable roundtrip 34, CH9.4 reconnect/recovery 53, CH9.5 coordinator 27 and CH9.5 persistent ENet recovery 41 assertions. DOCTRINE.short_description: Design doctrine describing how a large simulated world produces discovery, capability, infrastructure, consequences and history.
DOCTRINE.purpose: Keep gameplay/world-building principles reusable and aligned with technical foundations without giving design documentation ownership of identity, authority, material or persistence systems.
DOCTRINE.expected_outcome: A durable design reference used to judge whether new simulation mechanics create interesting interconnected gameplay rather than isolated features.
DOCTRINE.progress_note: Doctrine remains an active design reference and must map new mechanics onto canonical queries, operations, transactions and persistent world consequences.
DOCTRINE.next_stage: Continue doctrine updates only when new gameplay/system evidence appears
